title: A capture publishes at most 2,000 fragments per segment
blocker: (`CONVERSATION_SEGMENT_FRAGMENT_LIMIT`). The bound exists because staged fragments live in memory: at 25,000 artifacts in one segment, peak RSS reached 602 MB and the segment was 44 MB. The number is a guess informed by one measurement; revisit it when the first real seeding pass runs. **Blocked on:** that first real seeding pass (v2 stage 3).
